correctness.rationale: In a cubic graph the inactive set loses exactly its vertices of induced degree at most one each synchronous round. Thus it vanishes exactly when the initial inactive graph is a forest. For a nonempty complement the bound 45−3k+e(S)≤29−k forces k≥8; a seed with empty complement is already larger. At k=8 the seed is independent and the complement is a tree, and conversely this suffices. For one exchange, each of the three pairs among the neighbors of the removed seed vertex gives a cycle in its union with the tree. A viable replacement must lie on all three corresponding tree paths, hence at their unique median. Deleting it leaves two or three tree branches, each joined exactly once to the returned seed vertex. The median has three incident edges in the tree plus returned vertex and hence no other seed neighbor. This proves the single replacement for each of eight seed vertices. Independently, the audit enumerated disjoint duad triples for the synthemes and scanned independent eight-sets by duad shore size, applying simultaneous pruning to each complement. It found 111,225 independent eight-sets and 12,780 contagious sets with the stated nine shore counts and six finishing-time counts. Connecting by common seven-subsets gave 51,120 edges and component-size counts {9:70,12150:1}; every nine-component has degree eight and so is K9. All four island shore profiles match. Adjacent transpositions on the six symbols independently gave exactly 40 orbits with multiplicities {15:2,60:2,90:3,120:4,180:4,360:19,720:6}.
residual_risks: The exhaustive run uses the independently proved independence reduction, not all unrestricted eight-sets. The S6 orbit census uses only the stated relabellings, not an action of the full automorphism group. On the empty-complement boundary the proof's forest edge inequality must not be used, but that case does not affect the minimum.

evidence: The cubic decycling lower bound is ceil((n+2)/4); Payan–Sakarovitch give equality for cyclically 4-edge-connected cubic graphs and an independent/tree partition when n=2 mod 4. Rapaport et al. treat random-initialization dissemination thresholds.
broader_coverage.reasoning: These cover the lower bound and the relevant existence/structure theory or a different probabilistic objective. No exact lists, round census or connectivity classification follow from those cited statements.

value.rationale: A canonical cubic girth-eight cage provides a natural exact test case where minimum feedback vertex sets are complements of maximum induced trees. Even though every optimum has eight exchanges, the graph fragments into seventy cliques and a giant connected component. This complete contrast between local and global mobility and the specified symmetry and timing profiles provide a useful baseline for reconfiguration and cascade models on cages.
residual_risks: No general cage result or structural description of the giant component beyond its size and connectivity is claimed.
